notices.title: Preliminary Testing Confirms Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza in Worcester County
notices.summary: State lab preliminarily detected H5N1 avian influenza at a Worcester County commercial broiler operation; NVSL confirmation pending, flock being depopulated.

history.status_text: State lab preliminarily detected H5N1 avian influenza at a Worcester County commercial broiler operation; NVSL confirmation pending, flock being depopulated.
Delaware reported a presumptive positive H5 HPAI case in a Kent County commercial broiler flock, which is being depopulated.
Preliminary tests found presumptive H5 avian influenza in a commercial broiler flock in Kent County, with samples sent to USDA NVSL for confirmation.
A commercial broiler flock in Caroline County, Maryland, preliminarily tested positive for HPAI; USDA NVSL confirmation is pending.
Federal lab testing confirmed H5N1 avian influenza at a commercial broiler farm in Kent County, Delaware.
